group_assessment.weighting: A stem-cell and sterol-disorder laboratory studying Dishevelled membrane association; WWOX appears in one discussion sentence. Credible for DVL2 localisation biology; no WWOX work. Not a per-author sweep.

field_density.note: LEGEND's WWOX-Dvl direction (DL-MOL-003) rests on unread cancer-cell primaries; this paper is the first source met that measures nuclear DVL2 together with a canonical Wnt reporter.

entries.proposition: The paper's only WWOX statement is one discussion sentence citing a head-and-neck cancer study (ref 79).
entries.snippet: It has been shown that silencing of the Wwox tumor suppressor increases nuclear DVL2 in head and neck cancer.79
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph on DVL2 protein-protein interactions

entries.proposition: Ref 79 is Celebi 2020 on Wwox silencing and Dvl nuclear import in head and neck cancer (PMID 32368285).
entries.snippet: Silencing of Wwox Increases Nuclear Import of Dvl proteins in Head and Neck Cancer.

entries.proposition: Sterol-synthesis inhibition shifted DVL2 from the membrane to the nucleus without changing total DVL2 (HEK293T).
entries.snippet: we observed that inhibitor treatments increased nuclear accumulation of DVL2 at the expense of membrane association (Figures 5D and 5E).

entries.proposition: Under the same conditions that put DVL2 in the nucleus, a TCF/LEF reporter showed canonical Wnt signalling inhibited, which the authors read as nuclear DVL acting independently of beta-catenin.
entries.snippet: Our findings show a clear inhibition of canonical Wnt signaling in response to cholesterol inhibited conditions (Figure S6E),30,31 suggesting nuclear DVL is functioning in a β-catenin independent manner.

entries.proposition: Figure S6E is a TCF/LEF luciferase readout with and without Wnt-conditioned medium across sterol conditions, three biological replicates.
entries.snippet: (E) Luciferase expression driven by TCF/LEF transcriptional activity in the presence of standard conditions (FBS), cholesterol depleted (LPDS), AY9944, Simvastatin, or U18666A treated conditions.

entries.proposition: Nuclear DVL2 was also increased in cerebral cortex of a Smith-Lemli-Opitz mouse model.
entries.snippet: Analyses of DVL2 within isolated cerebral cortices showed a significant increase in nuclear DVL2 and reduction in membrane-associated DVL2 in Dhcr7 Δ3-5/T93M mice compared to Dhcr7+/T93M controls (Figures 8E and 8F).

entries.proposition: The DVL2-p53 result is one representative co-IP in HEK293T.
entries.snippet: (D) Co-IP between endogenous DVL2 and p53 in HEK293T.

entries.proposition: Figure 7D shows a single unquantified blot in which the 10% input p53 band is itself stronger in the AY9944 lane than in the LPDS lane.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 7D: alpha-DVL2 IP, IgG and 10% input lanes for LPDS and LPDS+AY9944; Tp53 band near 50-75 kDa stronger in the AY9944 IP lane and also stronger in the AY9944 input lane; no quantification or N shown.

entries.proposition: Figure 8F plots five points per group although the legend states N = 3 independent experiments.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 8F bar chart (Dhcr7 WT/T93M vs Δ3-5/T93M; WCL, Nuc, Memb, Cyt): five open circles per bar.

entries.proposition: Nuclear DVL2 accumulation in this system is produced by inhibiting cholesterol synthesis, with membrane and cytosolic DVL2 falling in the same panel.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5E plots normalized DVL2 in three fractions: nuclear DVL2 rises above the LPDS bar with AY9944 (**) and U18666A (****), membrane DVL2 falls under AY9944, Atorvastatin, Simvastatin and U18666A (**, *, *, **) and cytosolic DVL2 falls under Simvastatin (*). Figure 5H plots nuclear/total GFP intensity rising under LPDS+AY9944 (****).
entries.anchor: Figure 5, panels E and H; native JPEG inspected

entries.proposition: The nuclear import route measured here is sterol-sensitive, PDZ-domain dependent and FoxK2 dependent, and a PDZ inhibitor abolishes it.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 6B plots relative FoxK2 co-immunoprecipitated with DVL2 rising in the nuclear fraction under LPDS+AY9944 (**) and falling in the cytosolic fraction (**). Figure 6E and 6F show that adding NSC668036 to LPDS+AY9944 returns both the GFP intensity per unit nuclear area and the nuclear/total GFP intensity to the untreated range (**** against LPDS+AY9944 in both panels). Figure 6C marks cholesterol-binding, FoxK2-binding and NSC668036-binding residues on overlapping faces of the same PDZ domain.
entries.anchor: Figure 6, panels B, C, E and F; native JPEG inspected

entries.proposition: The condition that maximises nuclear DVL2 carries the lowest canonical TCF/LEF response, and the panel reports no statistical test at all.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure S6E plots TCF/LEF fold induction with and without Wnt-conditioned medium. With conditioned medium the bars read approximately 125 (FBS), 67 (LPDS), 55 (LPDS+vehicle), 12 (LPDS+AY9944), 17 (LPDS+Simvastatin) and 21 (LPDS+U18666A); every bar without conditioned medium sits at approximately 5 to 7. No significance marker is drawn anywhere in the panel.
entries.anchor: Figure S6, panel E, page 9 of the supplementary PDF rendered at 200 dpi
entries.qualifies_needle: a clear inhibition of canonical Wnt signaling

entries.proposition: The control that makes the FoxK2 result a trafficking result rather than an expression result rests on two experiments.
entries.snippet:
Quantification of nuclear and cytosolic fractions demonstrate that FoxK2 expression
does not significantly change following sterol targeted treatments. N = 2 independent
experiments.
